why_this_is_genuinely_new: Every prior program in this project is CROSS-SECTIONAL: rank N instruments, hold the best. This is TIME-SERIES: each instrument is asked, independently, whether it is breaking out. The two mechanisms are close to orthogonal by construction.

Every prior program is US equities. This universe holds bonds, gold, commodities, currencies and international equity alongside sectors. The 'new asset classes' item was marked DATA_BLOCKED because it assumed futures were required; liquid ETF proxies with 33 years of daily OHLCV are already on disk.
Every SEC strategy begins in 2023 and has never seen a bear market. This has 1993-2026, covering the dot-com crash, the global financial crisis, COVID and 2022.
user_origin: Proposed by the project owner as an ORB-style idea. True opening-range breakout needs intraday bars, which do not exist here. The daily-bar analogue - channel and volatility breakout - is the closest faithful implementation and is the older, better-documented literature (Donchian channels; Turtle rules; Larry Williams volatility breakout).
universe_note: 35 ETFs with complete daily open/high/low/close/volume. Instruments with fewer than 500 daily bars at a decision date are ineligible.

declared_variants.donchian_20_10: Enter long when the close exceeds the trailing 20-day high; exit when it falls below the trailing 10-day low. The original Turtle short-term system.
declared_variants.donchian_100_50: A slower variant, included to show the parameter neighbourhood rather than to be selected from.
declared_variants.volatility_breakout: Enter when the close exceeds the prior close plus 0.5 times the 20-day ATR; exit on the reverse. Larry Williams style.

rules.unallocated_capital: held in SHY, the short-treasury proxy, earning its actual return
rules.sizing: equal weight across instruments currently signalled
rules.rebalance: daily evaluation, trades only on signal change

anti_overfitting.no_sweep: Four variants, all standard published parameterisations. No grid search, and the neighbourhood variant is reported rather than chosen from.

forward_intent: If this clears the historical bar it is to be frozen and added to the September 4 forward cohort, so it is tested on untouched data at the same time as the six existing strategies rather than on its own schedule.
